description: Prediction Market Signal Aggregator: Polymarket odds plus Reddit sentiment, divergence scoring, and ranked market signals.

input.topic: string — Market/topic query, e.g. bitcoin, US election, fed rate cut (required)
input.marketLimit: number — Optional Polymarket result count, max 20
input.redditLimit: number — Optional Reddit post count, max 50

output.sentiment: Reddit sentiment counts and top posts
output.signals: direction, confidence, impliedProbability, sentimentScore, divergence, notes
